Position Summary:

Lead enterprise adoption of MCP-based AI integrations by designing, deploying, and operationalizing secure tool ecosystems connecting LLMs with enterprise applications, APIs, and data sources.

Location:

Mumbai - India

What will your job entail

AI Forward Deployment Engineer - MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Experience: 5-8+ Years | Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

Lead enterprise adoption of MCP-based AI integrations by designing, deploying, and operationalizing secure tool ecosystems connecting LLMs with enterprise applications, APIs, and data sources.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement MCP servers, tools, resources, and prompts for enterprise AI platforms.
Build integrations across Azure, ServiceNow, Databricks, Microsoft 365, Jira, and line-of-business applications.
Define standards for tool discovery, access control, authentication, and governance.
Develop reusable MCP frameworks and SDK accelerators.
Establish observability, monitoring, and performance optimization practices.
Partner with AI architects and business teams to productionize enterprise use cases.

Required Skills

Python, TypeScript, MCP, REST APIs, OAuth, Azure, Kubernetes, AI integration architecture, enterprise security, API gateways, DevOps, observability.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Semantic Kernel, LangChain, Azure OpenAI, multi-tenant MCP architectures, and enterprise governance.

Core Competencies

Enterprise AI Deployment, Customer Engagement, Solution Architecture, Governance, Automation, Cloud Engineering, Production Support.
